seam.text: The ball is nipping about off the seam and {batting} are struggling. {cause}.

dead.text: It's a slow, low pitch and the ball is dying on its way through. {cause}.

uneven.text: Bounce is getting uneven: one rears, the next skids through. {cause}.

turn.text: The spinners are finding real turn now. {cause}.

dust.text: Puffs of dust as the ball lands. {cause}.

cracks.text: Cracks are opening across the strip. {cause}.

footholes.text: The footholes at the {end} are deepening. {cause}.

danger.text: The match referee walks out to inspect the pitch. {cause}.

true.text: A true pitch with good carry, and {batting} are making the most of it. {cause}.

causes.grass: There's {grassMm} mm of grass left on
causes.loose: The strip wasn't rolled tight enough
causes.longGrass: The long grass is cushioning the ball
causes.structureDamage: The strip was rolled when it was too wet, and it's breaking up
causes.cracks: The clay has dried out and cracked
causes.footholes: The footholes have been dug out by the seamers
causes.surfaceWear: The surface is worn and crumbling
causes.rough: The bowlers' follow-through has roughed up the surface
causes.hard: It's been well rolled and has dried hard
causes.lastingWear: The strip is tired from the matches already played on it this season
causes.thinEnds: The ends haven't grown back since the strip was last used

rain: Rain stops play. The covers come on.
